extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from the extraction job: SI2309A, UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd, p-channel MOSFET, LCSC C2681220.
The supplied PDF title and page headers identify UMW SI2309A; the document footer names UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited and the job manufacturer identity is retained at the top level.

Figures on pages 3 and 4 contain usable typical curves. Listed points are compact direct readings rounded to plotted-grid resolution and are not interpolated; p-channel voltage and current curve axes are represented as magnitudes as directed by the MOSFET archetype.

The strict MOSFET schema has no dedicated fields for absolute maximum ratings, IDSS, IGSS, ID(ON), gFS, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery time, continuous body-diode current, thermal resistance, or SOA; available values were not added outside schema.

Additional table values include IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = -48 V, VGS = 0 V and 50 uA at VDS = -48 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 125 degC; IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VDS = 0 V, VGS = +/-20 V; ID(ON) minimum -6 A at VGS = -4.5 V, VDS = -10 A as printed; and gFS typical 1.9 S at VDS = -4.5 V, ID = -1 A.
Additional gate-charge values are Qg = 5.4 nC typical and 12 nC maximum at VGS = -10 V, Qgs = 1.15 nC typical at VDS = -30 V, and Qgd = 0.92 nC typical at ID = -1.25 A.

Additional timing values are td(on) = 10.5 ns typical and 20 ns maximum, tr = 11.5 ns typical and 20 ns maximum, td(off) = 15.5 ns typical and 30 ns maximum, and tf = 7.5 ns typical and 15 ns maximum at VGS = -4.5 V, VDS = -30 V, RL = 30 ohm, RGEN = 6 ohm, ID = -1 A.
Additional body-diode values are trr = 30 ns typical and 55 ns maximum at IF = -1.25 A and dI/dt = 100 A/us, and maximum continuous IS = -1.25 A.

Absolute maximum ratings include VDS = -60 V, VGS = +/-20 V, ID = -1.25 A at TA = 25 degC and -0.85 A at TA = 70 degC, IDM = -8 A, IAS = -5 A with L = 0.1 mH, PD = 1.25 W at TA = 25 degC and 0.8 W at TA = 70 degC, RthJA = 100 degC/W for t <= 5 sec and 166 degC/W steady state, RthJC = 60 degC/W, TJ = 150 degC, and TSTG = -55 to 150 degC.
